cms.permissionExplanation: EmDash checks token scopes and the account role together. Local EmDash 1.3 guidance identifies Contributor (20) as able to create content and edit owned drafts, but unable to publish. Author (30) can publish owned content. The live session successfully created an author-owned draft, while schema_get_collection was explicitly denied because schema:read was absent. Content-writing access does not grant schema access or bypass Contributor publishing limits. Publishing was not attempted, so runtime publish rejection was not independently tested. Contributor draft-read access is broader than edit ownership and may include other authors' drafts.

discoveryIssues: Early escaped-JSON and stop-parsing shell forms failed before a useful MCP invocation; plain single-quoted JSON succeeded.
A schema_get_collection invocation using collection instead of slug returned argument validation error; the corrected slug invocation exposed the actual schema:read denial.
One quote-heavy source search returned invalid regular expression; the relevant seed and editing-flow files were then read through the runner.
